thread:
Priya Shah: Kicking off Tidewell pilot onboarding thread. Want to align stakeholders, clear go/no-go criteria for first 60 days, and a compact timeline. Proposing Friday 4/2 9:30am PT for a 30m kickoff. Agenda: owners, infra access, pilot success metrics, risks.

Jordan Hayes: Friday 9:30 works. Quick note: Tidewell is aiming for OIDC SSO + user-scoped rate limits.

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): Correct, we'll use OIDC via Azure AD. Pilot scope: triage KB + support transcripts (~12k docs) then expansion if pilot met.

Leo Murphy: Thanks Erin. For OIDC we need the test app/client id and metadata. Also, for on-prem connectors we'll need a small outbound path to our ingestion endpoint.

Priya Shah: I'll steward the onboarding cadence and renewal signal. Primary success signals proposed: 1) Data ingest complete and searchable, 2) Pilot NPS >= 35 after week 4, 3) p95 latency < 300ms in staging under pilot load, 4) no PII leakage flagged in privacy eval. Thoughts?

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): Add: must pass our internal PHI scoping checklist (legal review) before go-live.

Jordan Hayes: Good call. Also propose an adoption metric: internal users completing 3 tasks/day on average during pilot week 3.

Priya Shah: Updated. Owner matrix (draft):
- Tidewell exec sponsor: Dr. Erin Kim
- Tidewell infra: Marco Ruiz (will confirm)
- Redwood CSM: Priya Shah
- Redwood Solutions: Jordan Hayes -> workshop & evals
- Redwood Infra: Leo Murphy -> staging + connectors

Leo Murphy: Network snippet for infra team (staging egress):
```
# Redwood staging endpoints
allow tcp 443 -> 10.12.0.0/20
allow tcp 8443 -> 10.12.1.5
```

Leo Murphy: Also, we'll spin up a small Dedicated pool + autoscale margins. I'll post proposed capacity numbers after I see sample QPS (estimate needed by Tue).

Priya Shah: Proposed 0-60 plan (high level):
- Day 0-3: access & SSO test + staging deploy
- Day 4-14: data ingest, initial indexing, smoke tests
- Day 15-30: internal pilot + workshop (Jordan leads)
- Day 31-45: iterate on feedback, cost baseline, regression checks
- Day 46-60: go/no-go review and ramp plan or extend pilot

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): Timeline looks reasonable. I'll loop in legal for PHI checklist and confirm Marco for infra by Mon.

Jordan Hayes: I'll prepare a 90-min enablement + evaluation session for week 3 and a short prompt/eval pack to run automated regressions.

Priya Shah: Risks to track now:
- PHI/legal gating may delay go-live
- OIDC metadata + test creds delayed -> blocks staging
- Data quality issues (transcripts need cleaning) -> extend indexing window

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): We'll prioritize redacting sensitive fields before ingest; legal will confirm allowed columns.

Priya Shah: Renewal signal: treat pilot completion + usage and NPS as leading indicators. If NPS < 30 or usage < baseline we'll schedule an executive review at week 5.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Tidewell Pilot Kickoff" Fri Apr 2 9:30am PT  invite sent to Erin, Priya, Jordan, Leo. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/tidewell-pilot-0402

Leo Murphy: Action items before kickoff: 1) Tidewell to share OIDC metadata + test client (by Tue), 2) Tidewell to upload 2k sample transcripts (by Tue), 3) Marco or infra lead contact (by Mon). I'll post capacity draft by Tue EOD.

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): Will do. Thanks all.

Jordan Hayes: Bringing a short checklist to the meeting: eval templates, prompts, success gating map.

Priya Shah: Great. I'll drop the compact 0-60 owner table in this thread before EOD today. Please ping me if availability changes.

Dr. Erin Kim (Tidewell): Looking forward to it. :smile:

calendar-bot: Reminder set for 15m before meeting.
